review_description: Installation took over 12 weeks. After doing an internet search on the company, it appears they are no longer trading and facing legal action.
The only supplier who came out to measure & quote without being hassled into coming.
The sales person was very helpful. Advising us where to install units as it was not capable of fitting on my main roof.
Time constraints due to June 30 cut off period for rebate changes. Made our decision of supplier more hasty than would otherwise have been the case.

Because we started obtaining quotes so close to the 30 June rebate cutback most were for the increased price, as installation would have to be after 1st of July.  Cleaner Energy managed to get us installed before the 30 June, for the discounted price.  The package included a 3kw inverter, in case we want to add more panels later on, and for almost the same price as the 1.5kw.  The technicians who installed worked fast and were very informative.
I'm having problems getting answers to questions right now, haven't heard a dicky bird in 2 months, since I paid $ up front
So far no installation.  Very slow with postal communications.
